selection_rule.selection: Take the complete complement of historical300, excluding every known exposed source UID, raw SHA256 or full operational group from the recorded metadata inventories. No substitutions and no outcome-dependent selection. If fewer than300 remain, retain the actual eligible count.
selection_rule.ordering: Ascending source_uid Unicode codepoint order, then group_id; ordering only, no sampling
selection_rule.future_failure_policy: Do not replace members for safety blocks, decode failure or quality failure; analysis rules must be frozen separately.

raw_hash_provenance: Copied existing raw_sha256 values from pinned admitted split metadata and source-manifest receipts, with equality checked by source identity. Raw bytes never opened or rehashed; path checks only. Recorded pins copied from fresh-cohort-availability.md and not newly rehashed. Source metadata documents prelock native integrity/canonical/leakage engineering reads.

limitations: Fresh denotes absence from checked scientific source inventories, not proof that nobody has ever viewed or decoded an image.

Coverage is bounded to named schedules, admitted reservations, MAIN development manifest files and retained m1b-confirm execution input bindings. Individual outcomes and arbitrary private history were not inspected.
Modern research/development-sources.md was absent in MAIN and journal checkout; the original32 reservation is not a complete modern ledger.
Development manifests without explicit source identity fields, run.json-only exposure and unrecorded actor access may not be covered. No claims of exhaustive exposure coverage.
Finite linked grouping is an operational leakage screen; population independence is not certified.
Per-image rights remain pending; local restricted academic research metadata does not authorize public redistribution, figures or new scientific access.
Inventory does not authorize calibration access, held-out pixels, scientific execution, lifecycle transition or source-plan amendment.
Only IDs/groups/existing digests were used to select sources. One development evidence inventory was encountered containing existing aggregate development summaries; no held-out outcomes were read.
